section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Wipers and Washers
title: Front Wiper Motor

content.description: Wiring diagram showing front wiper motor connector with terminals 1-6 labeled, two circular connectors shown on right side with grid patterns

content.text: 1. INSPECT THAT MOTOR OPERATES AT LOW SPEED

items: (a) Disconnect the connector from the wiper motor.
(b) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 2. Connect the negative (−) lead to the motor body.
(c) Check that the motor operates at low speed.

content.description: Wiring diagram showing front wiper motor connector with terminals 1-6 labeled, two circular connectors shown on right side with grid patterns, with different connection configuration than diagram 1

content.text: 2. INSPECT THAT MOTOR OPERATES AT HIGH SPEED

items: (a) Disconnect the connector from the wiper motor.
(b) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1. Connect the negative (−) lead to the motor body.
(c) Check that the motor operates at high speed.

content.description: Simplified wiring diagram showing battery connection to wiper motor at raised position, with dashed line indicating connection path

content.text: 3. INSPECT THAT MOTOR OPERATES, STOPPING AT RAISED POSITION

items: (a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 2. Connect the negative (−) lead to the motor body.
(b) Operates the motor at low speed.
(c) Stop the motor operation to disconnect the battery terminals except at the raised position.

content.description: Two circular motor terminal diagrams showing internal contact positions, with terminals 2, 3, 4, and 7 labeled

items: (e) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 4. Connect the negative (−) lead to terminal 7.
(f) Inspect that the motor stops running at raised position after the motor operate again.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the motor.
